materials.content:
Watercolor on moderately thick, cream, smooth wove paper with a slightly fuzzy feel
(Source: Paper Survey researched by Judith C. Walsh and published in Lynes, 1999.)

cr_data.provenance:
[1] 1960, purchased from (Downtown Gallery, New York, New York, USA) by Allen-Bradley Co. (Milwaukee, Wisconsin, USA); [2] 1969, gift to The Bradley Family Foundation (Milwaukee, Wisconsin, USA); 1977, gift to Milwaukee Art Center (Milwaukee, Wisconsin, USA) 
NOTES: 
[1], [2] Barbara Buhler Lynes, Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. Vol. 1 (New Haven: Yale University Press, 1999), p. 124, cat. 223. 
(Source: MAM, 2025)
remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive. "3" in verso inscription probably indicates third in the series and that it was painted 23 August. See cat. nos. 1797, 1801, 1802. (Source: Lynes, 1999)
